notes: All cooked meal packets should bear QR Code with details of Name of unit, FSSAI license no., Veg./Non-veg item name, Grammage etc. and date of packing and Veg/N.Veg. Symbol as per FSSAI norm.
Pre-mix Tea/Coffee/Green Tea/Malt beverage should be served with Stirrer, disposable hard paper/ corn starch cups, paper napkin & Hot Water in flask.
Only boneless chicken should be used in chicken dish preparation. Neck & wing portions of chicken should not be served.
The menu should be served on cyclic basis.
Service of Morning Tea/Breakfast/Lunch/Dinner to be done in acrylic trays (as per tray colour to differentiate Veg./N. Veg.).
Service Evening Snacks to be preferably done in Snacks Box with co-branding of Vande Bharat Train.
All the pakaging materials including disposable items may be as per colour scheme of Vande Bharat Express with co-branding of IRCTC and Licensee.
Tray mat with Bi-lingual Menu/QR code to be used.
For the passengers of Excecutive Class, the services will be more personalized through high quality crockery, cutlery, napkin etc.

All food items should be individually packed & served in coloured Teflon coated Aluminium Casseroles (60-70 micron)/Corn starch packing material and Parottas/Chappathis should be packed/served in aluminum wrapper.
Malt Beverages to be provided to Children instead of Tea/Coffee.
